scope: Proposition 1.3 of the manuscript “The reverse logarithmic Kodaira inequality and additivity” (preprints/The-reverse-logarithmic-Kodaira-inequality-and-additivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 499df173e9f8ba2d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let f, E, D satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, and let 0 ̸= s ∈ H0(X, mLX) for some m > 0. Then κ(Y, LY ) ≥ 0. If κ(Y, LY ) = 0 and s vanishes iden- tically on Xy for some y ∈ V , there are an integer a > 0 and a nonzero τ ∈ H0(Y, aLY ) with τ(y) = 0.
